answer: Random peer audit: a lottery pairs each identity with a random peer, with a mirror audit by a second auditor. Auditors stake 200,000 POA; correct audits earn 30,000, false ones burn it. Honest agents find it velvet-smooth. A farmer with 100 fakes cannot foresee the auditor, so fakes are caught by the pulse of identical trades. One forged history costs 500,000 POA, so 100 fakes cost 50,000,000 POA, more than any reward; honest agents pay once.
